component.name: Cajole
component.summary: A gentle alarm clock for Phosh

description.p: Cajole is an alarm clock for GNOME-based Linux phones. Alarms ramp up gradually through volume, vibration and screen glow, and can be dismissed early from a notification before they ring.

ul.li: Gentle wake ramps for volume, vibration and screen brightness
Holiday Mode for pausing regular alarms and adding temporary ones
Downloadable sounds and custom sound files

description.p: Cajole now uses far less memory while it waits in the background.

ul.li: The alarm scheduler runs in a small background process, and the window opens in its own process that exits when you close it
The ring screen opens a moment after the alarm starts; the notification buttons still work instantly

description.p: Automatic brightness is now restored to its previous state after an alarm.

ul.li: Cajole can now read the real automatic brightness setting, so it no longer turns it on when you had it off

description.p: Automatic brightness is now paused properly during an alarm.

ul.li: The pause now changes the real setting instead of a private copy inside the sandbox
If Cajole is killed during an alarm, automatic brightness is restored the next time it starts
New donation link and an update contact
Brand colours, and notes for earlier releases
The About dialog uses the new donation link

description.p: The app icon is resized to match other GNOME app icons.

ul.li: A GNOME Clocks-style time picker and alarm list
Gentle wake: volume, vibration and screen brightness ramp up
Early-dismissal notifications before an alarm rings
Holiday Mode for pausing regular alarms and adding temporary ones
Downloadable alarm sounds and custom sound files
